title.zh: THORChain rejects Bitget request to block hacker as $6 million moves to bitcoin
title.en: THORChain rejects Bitget request to block hacker as $6 million moves to bitcoin

current_state.zh: THORChain refused Bitget's request to blacklist addresses tied to the exchange's $387.5M hack, even as CoinDesk traced 27 swaps moving ~2,390 ETH ($6.3M) into 75.2 BTC via the protocol.
